plan.title: The agent's failures, as expect tests
plan.author: pratos with Claude Code
plan.summary: When the model keeps failing, the agent's Run should end as a fact everyone can read, not hang. This stage adds `FailRun` and `RunFailed`, fails a Run with the reason after three tries, and tells it as stories: the domain, the agent loop, pi-durable after a restart.
plan.current: cp-07 has the restyled plan page and sessions panel, and `just agent-serve` answering through pi-durable. When the model throws, the Run stays running: the loop retries it every 1.5 s forever, the queue behind it waits, and nobody in the Session is told.
discoveries: Only whoever started a Run can finish it (`packages/domain/src/session/decider.ts`); failing follows the same rule, so a person cannot fail the agent's Run.
The `runs` projection already has a `result` column; a failed Run keeps its reason there, so the panel needs no new field.
`packages/agent/src/loop.ts` takes the API and the brain as arguments, so tests drive it with the real session model and engine.
The faux model counts its calls (`fauxCallCount` in `model.ts`): that is how a test proves a restart made no second call.
`apps/api/src/plan-room.ts` lists the session commands it accepts; `FailRun` must join that list.
plan.endState: A Run the model cannot answer in three tries ends in `RunFailed` with the reason, and the next question is answered. Three stories read aloud like what happened, `just test` is green, and the panel shows the failed bubble.
notDoing: Retrying a failed Run; a person asks again, which queues a new one.
Backoff between tries; three quick tries, then the reason.
Failing a Run someone else started; only its starter can.
plan.approach: Domain first: the event is the contract the projection, the loop and the panel read. Then the loop and its stories. The bubble last, once a failed Run exists to show.

contexts.name: Agent work
contexts.about: Sessions where Participants ask the agent, and the Runs that answer them.

vocabulary.meaning: Command: whoever started a running Run ends it with a reason instead of a result.
Event: a Run ended without a result; carries who failed it and why.
The verb behind FailRun and RunFailed.

spec.question: How does a Run move from asked to its end?
spec.diagram:
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> Queued: Ask
  Queued --> Running: StartRun
  Running --> Running: Steer
  Running --> Finished: FinishRun
  Running --> Failed: FailRun
  Finished --> [*]
  Failed --> [*]
  note right of Failed: RunFailed, with the reason

steps.caption: Ask queues a Run behind any others in the Session.
StartRun takes the oldest queued Run; one runs at a time.
Anyone in the Session can steer it while it runs.
Whoever started it finishes it with a result.
New: whoever started it fails it with the reason.

decisions.question: What happens when the model keeps failing?
decisions.why: A failed Run is a fact with a reason: everyone in the Session sees why, and the queue moves on. Retrying forever blocks the queue; dropping it records an answer that never came.

viz.question: What happens when the model keeps failing?

options.label: Fail it after three tries
options.summary: Three tries, then FailRun with the last error; the next question starts.
options.diagram:
sequenceDiagram
  participant L as Agent loop
  participant M as Model
  participant R as Plan room
  L->>M: answer r1, try 1
  M-->>L: model unavailable
  L->>M: tries 2 and 3
  M-->>L: model unavailable
  L->>R: FailRun r1, with the reason
  R-->>L: RunFailed; r2 can start

axes.seen: Who could not answer, and why

options.label: Retry forever
options.summary: The loop keeps trying the same run every pass. What cp-07 does.
options.diagram:
sequenceDiagram
  participant L as Agent loop
  participant M as Model
  participant R as Plan room
  L->>M: answer r1
  M-->>L: model unavailable
  L->>M: again, every 1.5 s
  M-->>L: model unavailable

axes.seen: The agent is working on it, forever

options.label: Drop it silently
options.summary: Finish the run with no answer and move on.
options.diagram:
sequenceDiagram
  participant L as Agent loop
  participant M as Model
  participant R as Plan room
  L->>M: answer r1
  M-->>L: model unavailable
  L->>R: FinishRun r1, empty result

steps.caption: The agent asks the model; it fails.
Two more tries fail the same way.
FailRun records why; everyone in the Session reads it.
The queue moves on to the next question.
The same failure, every pass, with no end.
The run finishes as if answered; the question is lost.

phases.name: Domain: a Run can fail, with a reason
phases.goal: The session decider accepts `FailRun` from whoever started the running Run and records `RunFailed`; the projection marks it `failed`.

changes.intent: Add `FailRun`, `RunFailed` and the verb Fail under Run, before code names them.
The command, the event, and the `FailRun` case in `decide`.
`RunFailed` sets the Run's status to `failed` and keeps the reason in `result`.
`RunStatus` gains `failed`.
Accept `FailRun` among the session commands.
The story 'the agent cannot finish, and says why', snapshot `__expect__/agent-fails.snap.txt`.

manual.text: Read `agent-fails.snap.txt` aloud: Pratos is refused, then the agent fails it.

phases.name: The loop: three tries, then FailRun
phases.goal: The agent fails its own Run with the last error after three thrown answers, and its stories run on the real session model and engine.

changes.intent: After `ATTEMPTS` thrown answers, send `FailRun` with the last error as the reason.
Two stories on in-memory SQLite: answers in order and resumes its own; fails after three.
`answers-in-order.snap.txt` and `fails-after-three.snap.txt`, committed and read in review.
Faux model: the same Run after a restart is answered from the store, one call.

manual.text: Read `fails-after-three.snap.txt` aloud; the next question is still answered.
In `answers-in-order`, the agent leaves Pratos's Run alone and resumes its own.

phases.name: The failed bubble
phases.goal: A failed Run shows in the sessions panel where the answer would be: who could not answer, and the reason.

changes.intent: Status `failed` renders `gh-bubble-failed` with the reason from `result`.

components.name: Run, ended
components.notes: A failed run says who could not answer and the reason, in amber, where the answer would be.
